about: [#553 B2: the band block moved to gate 247 with the split of gate 26, so the two band situations run gate 247 (G247=1); their names keep their wording so the breaks' mustFailIn still names them.] Gates 26 (invariants) and 48 (lesson flow) were found NOT flaky (the finding is on the job): their archived reds were the lesson-board latch #522 fixed, deliberate re-pins, and #537's font alias. So the breaks re-create those causes: a drifted icon (what gate 26's invariant 3 guards), a lesson note 8px taller (what moved gate 48's board pins), and the font calibration refused by fontconfig (the #537 state, a double hyphen in gates/fonts.conf's comment). Every line of both gates is graded. Gate 26 runs narrowed to one geometry per situation (CT_INV_GEOS, about 3 minutes each); gate 48 runs whole (about 11 minutes). NOT COVERED: gate 26's other ten geometries in this pair (the full suite runs them all). BATCH 13 ADDS THE LIVE CAUSE THE ORCHESTRATOR'S CHECK FOUND (its gap of 18 Nov 2026: gate 26 red 1 in 20 at se rev-ply31 under load, the explanation card's centre on the eval graph while the refutation clause was still coming): a fourth situation, gate 26 at 320x568 running its TC-R239 block alone (CT_INV_ONLY=band: every animation frame from the jump to a pending reason until 2s after it is final - where the cause is asserted since jobs/gate-26-goes-red-at-ply-31-on-the-small-phone-while-the-explanation-is-still-coming-2026-11-18 fixed it in the app), and a fourth break that re-creates the cause (the reason box's pending mark never set, so the band puts the graph into the one-line reason while the clause is coming), which must fail there. The full gate at 320x568 is not added: its main walk's rev-ply31 no longer pends (16.Qb8+ is final at once since c71cd95e), so it cannot see this cause either way; the two full-gate situations above also run TC-R239 now. #553 (B1): the fourth break had gone stale twice over - its patch no longer applied (rev-why-txt moved from chess.jsx:13062 to :13973 and gained data-say and data-last), so the pair would read ERROR, and once refreshed it was BLIND at se, because since batch 13's FB-07 the eval graph is not drawn in the reason box on a short phone at all (TC-R239e at se asserts 0 graph frames), so nothing can sit over a pending reason there. Measured on #553 trial bundles: the refreshed break at se band 18 PASS 0 FAIL (blind); at kunal761 band 14 PASS 4 FAIL (TC-R239b and TC-R239d at plies 19 and 25); the real code at kunal761 band 18 PASS 0 FAIL. So a fifth situation, gate 26 at kunal761 running the band block, is where that break must fail; se's band block stays as a situation the real code must pass.
cmd: if [ -n "$G48" ]; then node gates/regress/48-lesson-flow.js; elif [ -n "$G247" ]; then node gates/regress/247-invariants-unswept-states-every-ply-and-the-band.js; else node gates/regress/26-invariants.js; fi
